lines.text: Hannah planned all five of Utah's national parks in three days.
She spent most of it in the car,
and saw each trail for an hour.
Here's the fix. Plan the drive before the hikes.
Some of the parks are hours apart,
so pick two or three for a short trip and stay near each one.
Save the rest for next time.
On her next trip, Hannah hiked Bryce at sunrise, no rush.
Save this before you plan Utah.
